_: Scalp skin under the hair: thick dermis (~1.6 mm, E), dense terminal follicles (~215-230 /cm2), sebaceous glands 400-900 /cm2, over subcutaneous fat, the galea aponeurotica and a loose areolar plane that lets the scalp slide on the pericranium. Contact with the outside world is mostly through hair (hair.* profiles). SKIN lane 11-07.

alpha.src: no scalp specular measurement; between the face's 0.27 and body's 0.35, oilier than the body (MOIST O1/O5)

n.src: as skin.body; a sebum film raises it toward 1.48 (MOIST O9)

structure.src: HAIRHEAD R1 (Caucasian F / V / O 230 / 226 / 214); MOIST O1; LAYERS dermis_mm.scalp 1.6 is EST

kinetic.src: as skin.body: no scalp skin friction found (touch on the scalp is through hair)

static.src: static taken equal to kinetic (skin friction is reported almost only as dynamic)

friction.counterface: smooth hard probe as skin.body unless stated

surface_energy_mJ_m2.src: not found; sebum-rich like the forehead (MAVON97 forehead CST 50.7 mN/m) - E

collision_thickness_mm.src: the epidermis; hair carries its own collision radius (hair.* profiles)

E_kPa.src: FENG22 OCE forearm incl. stratum corneum (small strain)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

compressible_to_fraction.src: a stiff thin shell: thins little under contact (E)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: dense fibro-fatty layer bound to the galea, a few mm (anatomy; not measured here)

E_kPa.src: fat in vivo E (SOFTTISSUE R31); the scalp's fibrous septa make it firmer (E)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: aponeurosis ~1 mm plus the gliding plane (E)

E_kPa.src: aponeurosis is tendon-like (MPa-scale in tension); 500 kPa in compression a placeholder (E)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: series stack of compliance_layers: E_eff = T / sum(t_i / E_i) = 34.11 kPa over T 6.66 mm, / T; initial (small-strain) value; each layer stiffens with strain (skin as skin.body)

ramp.src: IPC-style log barrier inside collision_thickness keeps surfaces apart; the tissue's own stiffening (exponential in strain) carries the load beyond it

restitution.src: thin soft stack on bone: low end of skin.body's range

sliding_plane.v: the scalp slides on the pericranium through the loose areolar layer: tangential compliance high, normal compliance low

model.src: no scalp hyperelastic fit in hand

E_kPa.src: not retrieved: Trotta & Ni Annaidh 2019 (J Mech Behav Biomed Mater 103381) tested human and porcine scalp in tension (human ~half porcine modulus and UTS; numbers not read); Raposio 1998 flap stiffness 117.1 g/mm (no area: not convertible)

conductivity_W_mK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 0.372 W/mK (SD 0.059, 8 studies, range 0.322-0.498); 0.37 kept

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 3390.5 J/kgK (SD 233, 4 studies, 3150-3662)

density_kg_m3.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 1109 kg/m3 (SD 38, n 10, 1100-1125); ICRU44 ~1090: recalled, not re-read

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) from the three ITIS values above, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2 (the 'feels warm/cold' number)

emissivity.src: STEKETEE73 abstract re-read 11-08 (paper paywalled; abstract text via a reproduction): skin 0.98 +/- 0.01, independent of wavelength over the measured 1-14 um; white, black and burnt skin measured (normal = burnt); separate per-pigment values are not given in the abstract

oily_day2.src: greasy scalp > 150 ug/cm2 one day after shampoo (MOIST O5); alpha step E
